messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: page fired for svc/inference-canary (policy: canary-5xx-rate). Trigger: 5xx rate > 10% over 3m in us-east-canary :rotating_light:

alex: acked the page <@alex> :hand: — jumping in to triage.

maria-oncall: oncall here. which rollout is this tied to? any customer-facing impact?

alex: looks like a quant-kernel experiment rolled to the canary pool ~4m ago by sam-deploy. Grafana: p95 token latency spiked + 5xx rate ~20% for canary shard. stable cluster unaffected so far.

sam-deploy: I just saw the PD page, thanks. this was the canary for deploy sha: 8f3a2b6 (quant-kernel-opt). deploy-bot shows:

```
deploy-bot: started rollout svc/inference -> canary (8f3a2b6)
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-canary -n prod-canary
```

sam-deploy: I'm going to start an immediate rollback to the previous image and scale down canary. initiating now.

sre-runbook-bot: recommended steps: 1) set canary route weight -> 0, 2) scale canary replicas -> 0, 3) rollback image on canary deployment, 4) monitor 5xx and latency for 10 minutes. runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/canary-503s

maria-oncall: taking step 1: routing change in progress (prod-router -> update weight). doing traffic shift to stable.

maria-oncall: `routectl set-weight svc/inference  canary=0 stable=100 --env=prod` — applied. 

alex: verifying metrics post-traffic-shift — still seeing a handful of 503s from canary pods but total request share is dropping. stitching logs:

```
[2026-03-14T21:14:02Z] inference-canary-xyz pod: kv-cache lookup failed: invalid-kernel-state
[2026-03-14T21:14:02Z] inference-canary-xyz pod: 503 POST /v1/generate  0B
```

sam-deploy: rollback job created: https://ci.redwood/job/rollbacks/1234 (PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1234) — rolling image back to 7c1d4a2. kicking pipeline now.

deploy-bot: rollback pipeline started (job id 9876).

kate-support: heads-up: support queue seeing a few tickets referencing 503s from the canary region. customers impacted appear to be a small subset on the new canary route only. flagging priority but not page-worthy for customer ops. I notified CS lead. :white_check_mark:

alex: if rollback finishes cleanly we'll watch p95 and 5xx for 10m then resolve. if 5xx persists we'll escalate to platform eng for kernel revert.

sre-runbook-bot: monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/canary-traffic?orgId=1 — alert muted for this thread.

sam-deploy: rollback completed at 21:19 UTC, pods restarted on image 7c1d4a2.

maria-oncall: checking metrics — p95 back to normal for canary traffic, 5xx rate trending to 0.5% (pre-rollout baseline).

alex: I'm going to clear the PD incident if no regressions in next 5m. marking as mitigated in the incident tracker and attaching notes.

kate-support: support notified customers in queue; adding a short blurb to the status page in case anything else shows up.

maria-oncall: closing traffic divert and scaling policies back to default.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident marked as mitigated by <@alex>. Closing page in 2m if no further alerts.

alex: closing now — final notes: cause = regression introduced by quant-kernel-opt (sha 8f3a2b6) in canary only; mitigation = immediate rollback to 7c1d4a2 + traffic diversion; customer impact = limited to canary cohort, small number of support tickets; follow-up = sam to open a postmortem and add regression test for kernel state. :memo:

sam-deploy: will file the follow-up PR and coordinate with ML infra to reproduce locally. pinging @research-team for postmortem.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page resolved (incident id pd-78901).
